scenario.description: A director of continuing education must approve the room, schedule, seating limit, and access setup for a Saturday make-up examination at a community college, with input from the registrar, accessibility services coordinator, and facilities manager.

shared_context.S1: Eighteen students need a Saturday make-up examination for a continuing-education certificate course.
shared_context.S2: The college has proposed North Hall and South Hall as possible examination rooms.
shared_context.S3: North Hall is normally listed for 24 seats, while South Hall is normally listed for 20 seats.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Mira Shah gives final approval for the examination room, schedule, seating limit, and access setup.
shared_context.S5: The college's routine approval process includes a report from the registrar, accessibility services, and facilities before the final approval is signed.
shared_context.S6: After the registrar, accessibility services, and facilities reports have been heard, Dr. Shah records the final approval and the responsible offices carry out the listed booking, access, and room-preparation steps; no additional room inspection is part of this approval meeting.

PF1.text: The registrar's confirmed examination calendar reserves Saturday, February 14, 2026, from 9:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. for this make-up examination; Mr. Brooks finalized the calendar this week but the booking has not yet been entered in the continuing-education scheduling system.

PF2.text: An approved access plan requires one student to use a screen-reader workstation and receive 135 minutes for the examination instead of the standard 90 minutes; Ms. Ruiz completed the access-plan review this week but has not attached it to the room request.

PF3.text: A recent facilities inspection confirmed South Hall's permitted examination occupancy at exactly 20 people and confirmed accessible power and desk space for the required screen-reader workstation. North Hall's permitted examination occupancy is exactly 18 people, leaving no permitted place for the proctor in addition to the 18 students. South Hall can be used with an occupancy record and a facilities-unlock request for the Saturday session; Mr. Hart has not updated the room listing yet.

acceptance_conditions: The examination must be scheduled for February 14, 2026.
The standard examination duration must remain 90 minutes.
The student covered by the access plan must receive 135 minutes.
A screen-reader workstation must be provided.
The permitted occupancy must be set at exactly 20.
An accessibility implementation commitment must be recorded.
A South Hall occupancy and Saturday-unlock commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C8: any('screen-reader workstation' in c['detail'] and '135-minute' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: decisions['permitted_occupancy'] == 20 and any('South Hall' in c['detail'] and 'occupancy' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('South Hall' in c['detail'] and 'unlock' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed calendar changes the examination date to February 14, 2026 and the start time to 9:30 a.m. instead of leaving the session on an unconfirmed generic Saturday schedule.
The approved access plan changes the student's examination time to exactly 135 minutes, requires a screen-reader workstation, and creates the accessibility implementation commitment.

The inspection changes the selected room to South Hall because its permitted occupancy is exactly 20 with the required workstation space, changes the settlement occupancy to exactly 20, and requires a South Hall occupancy-and-unlock commitment.
